proposal.summary: In affected GitLab EE versions, an external user granted Owner role on a group can create a service account in that group which is not classified as external, allowing privilege escalation to access internal projects.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab EE versions starting from 16.1 before 16.1.5; starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: This service account is not classified as external and may be used to access internal projects.

AV.quote: If an external user is given an owner role on any group, that external user may escalate their privileges on the instance by creating a service account in that group.

PR.quote: If an external user is given an owner role on any group, that external user may escalate their privileges on the instance by creating a service account in that group.

S.quote: This service account is not classified as external and may be used to access internal projects.

C.quote: This service account is not classified as external and may be used to access internal projects.

I.quote: This service account is not classified as external and may be used to access internal projects.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce by creating an external user with Owner role on a test group, create a service account in that group, and confirm whether the service account can access internal projects; if confirmed, prepare patch to ensure service accounts inherit 'external' classification or prevent external users from creating service accounts.

evidence_quotes.quote: An issue has been discovered in GitLab EE affecting all versions starting from 16.1 before 16.1.5, all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5, all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1.

evidence_quotes.claim: Privilege escalation via service account creation
evidence_quotes.quote: If an external user is given an owner role on any group, that external user may escalate their privileges on the instance by creating a service account in that group.
This service account is not classified as external and may be used to access internal projects.
